room_rent.note: Ratable proportion of associate medical expenses applies if higher room category is chosen

icu.note: No explicit ICU sub-limit mentioned; covered under hospitalisation expenses

copayment.note: Applies to each and every claim for insured persons whose entry age is 61 years or above; on individual policy applies to that individual, on floater applies to all insured persons if eldest member's entry age is 61+

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the policy wording beyond the deductible and room rent proportionality

deductible.note: Aggregate deductible; exact options not listed in wording but ₹50,000 used in premium illustration. After 4 continuous years, policyholder may opt to remove deductible at renewal subject to conditions.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage; reducible via portability credits

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailments (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT disorders, kidney stones, varicose veins, etc.) excluded for 24 months

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Code Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no specific rate or maximum percentage is stated in the wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: Extensive list of 541 day-care procedures covered as per Annexure I

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under Clause 4.2(xv)

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered under Benefit 6 up to Sum Insured for in-patient care at registered AYUSH hospitals within India

organ_donor.note: Organ donor medical expenses covered under Benefit 3 up to the amount specified in Policy Schedule for eligible donors under Transplantation of Human Organs Act

ambulance.note: Ambulance/travel/transportation expenses are explicitly excluded under Clause 4.2(x)

modern_treatments.note: 12 specific advance technology methods covered under Clause 3.1(d) including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc. Other advance technology methods are excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items are excluded per Annexure II (List I, II, III, IV); gloves, ECG electrodes, nebulisation kits etc. excluded

global_cover.note: Benefit 5 'Enhance Anywhere' covers treatment outside India for 5 major illnesses (Cancer, Benign Brain Tumour, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Heart Valve Replacement, CABG) on reimbursement basis; must be specified in Policy Schedule

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back applies; claims cannot be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date

notable_exclusions.display: Ambulance, domiciliary hospitalisation, OPD, maternity, consumables, non-listed advance tech, RMO/surcharges, tobacco/alcohol-related illness

optional_riders.display: Everyday Care (OPD helpline, wellness discounts), Expert Opinion (major illnesses), Enhance Anywhere (overseas treatment for 5 major illnesses)
